system.description:
The soul of a dragon burns within you, the scales of your body are like forged steel. You are a kiln and your heritage the coals that stoke your flames. Call upon your wrath, to speak in the tongue of your ancestors and imbue unbridled fury into your attacks.

Draconic Heritage

+1 Armor. [A]

When you attack: deal an additional LVL+KEY damage (ignoring armor) divided as you choose among any of your targets; recharges whenever you Safe Rest or gain a Wound.

You know Draconic if your INT is not negative. [M]

Dragonborn Horns: Descendant of Majesty — Proudly curved horns mark your gallant ancestry.

Challenge Honor

(1/Safe Rest) Action: Taunt a creature you can see until the start of your next turn. You are also Taunted by that creature. [M]

Nim+ Volume I ancestry variant (LewisH, Santuric). Variants replace the base ancestry: pick this instead of the standard version. Note: variants make your hero stronger than normal.
